question: Do causal setup conditions convert the retained state-history movement forecast into more robust post-confirmation price capture?

periods.movement_predictions: monthly expanding-window OOF predictions from regime_utility_ablation_v1
periods.underlying_state_definition: frozen eight-state detector fitted on full 2024

sources.provider_price_basis: provider OHLC exactly as stored; no independent corporate-action adjustment

cohort.symbols: the twenty-two symbols present in the OOF prediction ledger
cohort.full_session_grid: ordered union of regular-session dates in the twenty-two provider tapes; inactive symbol/session sleeves are zero-return cash

movement_gate.threshold_source: already-frozen full-2024 raw_history predicted-range P75 from the preceding P&L contract

common_close_confirmation.activation: inspect the next one through three completed bars after the anchor
common_close_confirmation.upper_confirmation: first future close strictly above the completed anchor high
common_close_confirmation.lower_confirmation: first future close strictly below the completed anchor low
common_close_confirmation.direction: upper confirmation long; lower confirmation short
common_close_confirmation.entry: open of the bar immediately after confirmation
common_close_confirmation.exit: close of anchor plus horizon bars
common_close_confirmation.same_bar_direction_ambiguity: impossible because one close cannot be strictly above anchor high and below anchor low

pattern_hypotheses.definition: replace first intrabar high/low touch with a completed close outside the anchor range, then enter next bar
pattern_hypotheses.safety_risk: uses up to three future bars for confirmation, so entry and outcome accounting must begin strictly afterward
pattern_hypotheses.stop_condition: candidate lacks support or does not improve net daily return versus OCO at every horizon

pattern_hypotheses.definition: arm close confirmation only when the causal history-layer future-range forecast exceeds its frozen P75
pattern_hypotheses.safety_risk: threshold comes from full-2024 prediction distribution and is development-only
pattern_hypotheses.stop_condition: candidate does not improve net daily return versus ungated close confirmation at every horizon

pattern_hypotheses.definition: confirmation bar body is at least half its range and closes in the outer quartile in the breakout direction
pattern_hypotheses.expected_benefit: distinguish decisive closes from weak range escapes
pattern_hypotheses.safety_risk: confirmation quality is known only at that bar close; entry must remain next-bar open
pattern_hypotheses.stop_condition: candidate does not improve the gated baseline at every horizon

pattern_hypotheses.definition: mean provider bar range percentage over anchor and prior five bars is at most 75% of the mean over anchor and prior twenty-three bars
pattern_hypotheses.safety_risk: excludes early-session anchors and may reduce support
pattern_hypotheses.stop_condition: support fails or candidate does not improve the gated baseline at every horizon

pattern_hypotheses.definition: confirmed direction matches the sign of log close return from six completed bars before the anchor through the anchor close
pattern_hypotheses.safety_risk: trend and regime history may be redundant
pattern_hypotheses.stop_condition: candidate does not improve the gated baseline at every horizon

oco_baseline.open_gap_ordering: an open at or beyond exactly one trigger establishes that side first
oco_baseline.entry: worse of trigger or triggering-bar open

overlap_and_portfolio.greedy_rule: accept earliest ex-ante eligible anchor, then reject anchors with ordinal below accepted ordinal plus horizon, including when confirmation or setup quality fails
overlap_and_portfolio.daily_portfolio_return: mean of twenty-two fixed sleeves, inactive sleeves zero

costs.interpretation: sensitivity only; provider OHLC has no executable spread or impact

uncertainty.paired: candidate daily return minus its frozen baseline using aligned resampled dates

retention_gate_each_hypothesis.pass_interpretation: retain as a 2024 internal setup research hypothesis only; no strategy or edge claim
retention_gate_each_hypothesis.failure_interpretation: reject or leave descriptive; do not tune parameters on the opened result
